review:
The Wild Cash series with a golden finish – fruit, lucky stars and red sevens on a 5x3, 10-line grid. The three-stage bonus is the whole point.

Stage one: a selector moves around a track, landing on numbers (added to a central multiplier), Gold or Exit. Land Gold and stage two expands the central reel with values up to 210x. The final stage can push all the way to the 25,000x max. Very high volatility, 97.02% RTP.
pros: Excellent 97.02% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
